chapter: Forming the band in New York
title: Going to theaters and hearing other bands in 1935
summary: Daytimes he went from theater to theater, catching Fats Waller and the Dorseys.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Okay. And, what were you doing the rest of the day when you weren't playing your show? Musically. I mean the group.
Well, we just, like well, they did practically what they wanted to do. In the daytime?
Well, we, most of the time, I was in a show and going to theaters and other bands.
You know? And, cause I loved shows. So, I used to go from one
And who were some of the people that were playing in 1935 at this time that you were listening to in other shows?

Well, Fats Waller. I liked him very much, whenever he was. Well, whatever names that was there. I used to go down and catch the Dorseys a lot. I knew Jimmy and Tommy well. (Inaudible), I knew them well. I was doing that cause we used to also play some of the same dates in New York, like alternate with each other. But, if they had a good running picture along with the show, that's where I would be. Mostly all the names were there. I used to go there and see them.
